title: Me and my boy Claude Opus coded this feature complete asteroids roguelike in 48 hours
author: ScrwFlandrs

comments.author: ScrwFlandrs
comments.body: So I was making a non AI assisted game and got curious, paid for github copilot+ and started making this. Got kind of obsessed and spent about 20 hours over the past couple days making this game. 13,000 lines of pretty good code. Willing to answer any questions anyone might have

comments.author: Lithiyum
comments.body:
Would you mind including a list of what tools you used (and for what purpose) as well as their associated costs? I'm curious to know what is out there and what is worth it vs what isn't.

Much appreciated!
